desc: Ideation: prove optimal cost ∈ {1,2,3,-1} and enumerate the cost-1/cost-2 witness shapes and the cost-3 construction (op2 on argmin-R, op2 on argmax-L, op1 on any third index)

Implement the complete solution (I/O skeleton + cost-1 check + two-op1 check + containment check + disjoint check + cost-3 construction + -1 fallback), with all chosen indices distinct and the cost-3 pair being argmin R / argmax L

Validation by review: parsing (`data[2::2]`/`data[3::2]`) correct; containment sweep with (L asc, R desc) + running max R correctly finds a distinct container; disjoint test via argmin R vs argmax L valid after containment check guarantees a≠b; cost-3 argument (I_a∩I_b=[L_b,R_a] ⊆ every other interval) holds; -1 only when M≤2 with no 1/2-op witness (budget-bounded, hence correct); edge cases N=1, M=1, M=2, duplicate intervals covered; O(M log M) fits M=2·10⁵
